verdict.rationale: Fern's llms.txt analytics tab reports traffic by LLM provider (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.), which does distinguish some AI-agent traffic from general traffic, but this only covers llms.txt-based fetches, not a full breakdown against human traffic across the whole docs site. missing for 10: comprehensive AI-vs-human traffic segmentation across all docs traffic (not just llms.txt fetches), independent/hands-on verification of the analytics dashboard, and any human-traffic baseline comparison in the same view.
